lane: One explicitly returned Android lane; none selected by this contract
preconditions: Pinned isolated e2e app and matching observer hashes
Complete non-suppressing observation before and after a reader gesture

observer_policy.system_reader_menu: Retain screenshots and reader speech; do not claim an app-only tree covers a system overlay
observer_policy.deadlines: Existing SDK and client absolute deadlines remain unchanged

required_step_evidence: Host action timestamps and device snapshot uptime kept as distinct clocks
Raw gesture request and transport result
Observed accessibility-focused identity when in app
TalkBack-produced speech display video or actual spoken-output artifact
Complete app snapshot with nonce/package/PID metadata when applicable
Expected and observed state after activation

steps.action: Record original settings and artifact/reader identities
Enable TalkBack and its speech display through Settings
Reader next gesture produces a different focus and matching phrase
Second reader next gesture produces another focus and phrase
Reach Project tools and Circuit explorer by reader navigation and activation
Focus known toggle Reset and record its identity/value
Select named Activate through actual TalkBack Actions and hear changed value
Activate again through TalkBack and hear original value
Restore original reader/font/IME/rotation/developer settings and return lane

fail_stop: Wrong producer or changed installed bytes
Input transport silently replaced by direct semantic action
CLI dump or suppressing instrumentation used during reader phase
Incomplete or unauthenticated tree treated as complete
Action changes unexpected component or value
pass_scope: One reader handoff and input action on the recorded Android artifact
not_qualified: VoiceOver service behavior on the local iOS27 Simulator before its explicit probe runs
Speech audio quality when only captions are retained
physical_voiceover: Scheduled last; Xcode27 reader-service capability on Simulator is a separate NOT_RUN probe
